blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) urged pet owners who may have been defrauded by a pet crematorium in Cavite to file complaints after 29 dead dogs and cats were found dumped in a vacant lot in Bulacan. The deceased pets were reportedly taken to Ahjay Paws Aftercare Pet Crematorium in Bacoor City, Cavite, but their remains were later found in sacks dumped in a vacant lot in Barangay Minuyan Proper, San Jose del Monte, Bulacan.
